title: Sort names in capitals, stepping around the nulls

blocks.text: A stream happily carries `null` elements, but a method call on one, or `sorted()` with natural ordering, throws `NullPointerException`. Filter the nulls out explicitly, before anything touches them.
Write `SortedNames.sortedUpper(List<String> names)`. It returns the names upper-cased and sorted alphabetically (natural `String` order of the upper-cased text), leaving out `null` entries.
Capital letters sort before small ones in `String` order, so the order of your steps matters when the input mixes cases.

cases.says: It returns the names upper-cased and in alphabetical order.
Null entries are filtered out first; a stream carries nulls, and calling a method on one throws.
The order is that of the upper-cased names, so upper-casing comes before sorting.

concepts: Streams carry null elements, so nulls are filtered out before sorted() or a method call meets them.
